crossRefs.note: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because…
Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume…
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will…
Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from…
For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
My God, turn your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name…
